#### Starting every weight at the same value

Suppose every weight and bias of a fresh [MLP](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-feedforward-network) is set to 0.1.
It is then trained for 5 [epoch](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch)s on minibatches of 32,
with `torch.optim.SGD` at [learning rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-learning-rate) 0.1.
What happens to the 32 [units](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-unit) of its [hidden layer](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-hidden-layer)?
